lineage: Assessed by TRM Labs (2025) as a possible rebrand or successor of BlackCat/ALPHV (Rust, look-alike leak site, on-chain overlap); Storm-0501 is a known affiliate
summary: Embargo is a Rust RaaS seen since April 2024, mostly hitting US healthcare, business services and manufacturing. Affiliates such as Storm-0501 get in through unpatched edge and web applications (ManageEngine, Citrix NetScaler, ColdFusion), dump credentials with Impacket, keep access through RMM tools and exfiltrate with renamed Rclone. The operator's own toolkit is distinctive: the MDeployer loader runs from a scheduled task, decrypts RC4 payloads, reboots hosts into Safe Mode to disable security products, and drops MS4Killer, which loads the vulnerable probmon.sys driver (BYOVD) to kill EDR before encryption.
uniqueTraits: MDeployer forces a Safe Mode reboot (bcdedit safeboot + Safeboot\Network service registration, WinDefend removed) to disable security tools
MS4Killer BYOVD EDR killer using the revoked-signed probmon.sys minifilter (dropped as Sysprox.sys / Sysmon64.sys), compiled per victim
RC4-encrypted payload pair a.cache/b.cache in C:\Windows\Debug, launched by scheduled task Perf_sys and service irnagentd
Storm-0501 affiliate pushes the encryptor domain-wide with a GPO scheduled task 'SysUpdate'
Possible BlackCat/ALPHV lineage (Rust, leak-site design, wallet overlap)

chain.procedure: Affiliate Storm-0501 exploits Zoho ManageEngine CVE-2022-47966, Citrix NetScaler CVE-2023-4966 and ColdFusion 2016 (likely CVE-2023-29300 / CVE-2023-38203); TRM also reports exploitation of unpatched software and phishing/drive-by access.
chain.noAtomicReason: No local Atomic test exploits these CVEs; validate with vulnerability scanning / patch-state checks or a purple-team exploit range, not ART.

chain.procedure: Adds HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Safeboot\Network\irnagentd so the loader service starts in Safe Mode, and deletes the Safeboot\Network\WinDefend key so Defender does not.

chain.procedure: bcdedit /set {default} safeboot Minimal, then shutdown -r -f -t 00; in Safe Mode the loader renames security product directories and later removes the safeboot value.

chain.techniqueName: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
chain.procedure: MS4Killer (based on the public s4killer PoC) drops probmon.sys v3.0.0.4 (revoked ITM System cert) as Sysprox.sys/Sysmon64.sys, loads it as a minifilter (BYOVD) and kills the victim's specific EDR/AV processes; a BAT script disables another security product.

atomics.testName: Scattered Spider BYOVD (CVE-2015-2291 for Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver)
atomics.note: Loads a known-vulnerable signed driver (BYOVD), the same pattern with a different driver (local ART T1068 #1)

atomics.testName: Disable Arbitrary Security Windows Service
